mutants.description: Averages ATO annual income evenly across all 26 fortnights when payslip data is missing, violating the rule that ordinary income must be accounted for in the specific fortnight it was earned, derived, or received.
Conflates the ordinary income free area with the lower tier threshold, setting the free area to $150 instead of the statutory $100 per fortnight.
Applies upper range reduction (60%) to the entire excess whenever excess exceeds $150, rather than maintaining the marginal 50% rate on the first $150 of excess.
Misreads 1068-G17 by applying the 40% reduction rate only to the excess above $150 rather than applying it to the whole excess over the free area.
